description:
Freedom Technology Solutions Group is seeking a ServiceNow Software Developer to join our team and support an up-tempo, creative environment for an Intelligence Community (IC) customer located in Northern VA. Our culture thrives on innovation, creative curiosity, and cognitive diversity – the candidate shall provide development and process improvement support of Sponsor's Global Infrastructure Business System (GIBS) custom application suite and other Sponsor requirements on the enterprise and non-enterprise ServiceNow platforms.  

 
 Demonstrated experience using web development technologies,  specifically JavaScript , HTML, and CSS. 

 Demonstrated experience developing ServiceNow, or advanced experience with software development or experience with low-code development platforms and the aptitude to develop ServiceNow experience,

 Demonstrated experience with Flow Designer, creating catalog items, and an understanding of business rules.

 Demonstrated experience in business process analysis including evaluating customer need, internal processes, document business process models, and translating these models as functional technical requirements. 

 Demonstrated experience in systems evaluation such as identifying measures or indicators of system performance and the actions needed to improve or correct performance, relative to the goals of the system.  

 Demonstrated experience with process improvement such as analyzing functions, requirements, or existing capabilities and shortfalls.  

 Demonstrated experience with program management and project task management, and customer relations and outreach.  

 Demonstrated experience with IT and systems lifecycle management, including managing review boards, and change & release management. 

 Demonstrated experience with knowledge management, including developing feature release descriptions, and technical artifacts related to the development under this request. 

 
 Required Qualifications:

 
 Active Security Clearance with Polygraph

 Bachelor's degree and 10 years of demonstrated experience. 

 Front End Software Developer to support and All Source Data Modeling and Analysis team. 

 Provide Front End Developer support to deliver a prototype application frontend Interface utilizing JavaScript, Angular, and a containerized (Docker and/or Kubernetes is preferred), cloud (AWS) development platform, Elasticsearch integration, and AWS tools. 

 The application supports integrations that tie into other applications that support AI models on the backend. 

  

 What’s in It for You? 

 Flexible work environment

 A team mentality – work with friendly, like-minded professionals

 Work with innovative, cutting edge technologies

 Enjoy extremely competitive compensation and benefits

 A work-life balance you can count on

 Opportunities to grow and advance your career on our dime

  

 The Benefits You Get with Freedom 

 Amazing benefits including matching 401k, fully paid medical, and more

 Generous paid time off – including paid site closure days

 Competitive salary offerings

 Paid training and tuition reimbursement

 Referral bonuses

 Fully paid life and disability

 Annual logo wear allowance

 Company sponsored events (game nights, holiday party, summer party, happy hours)

 Interested in learning more about Freedom and our culture?  Contact us today!  We’re constantly hosting hiring events in our office and elsewhere, to help you get a sense of what life is like at Freedom before joining the team.

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability or veteran status
